details.name: Printing Sequence of Numbers with a Gap Between Adjacent Values (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that prints a sequence of numbers from 1 (inclusive) to 16 (exclusive) in increments of 4.

details.name: Printing Sequence of Numbers with a Gap Between Adjacent Values (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that prints a sequence of numbers from 7 (inclusive) to 35 (inclusive) in increments of 7.
